question: Two trains, A and B, of lengths 457 m and 113 m are running at speeds of 18 m/s and 20 m/s, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how much time will they cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance covered = Sum of lengths of trains = 457 + 113 = 570 m

Since trains are moving in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum of their speeds.

Relative speed = 18 + 20 = 38 m/s

Time taken = Distance ÷ Speed = 570 ÷ 38 = 15 s

**∴ The correct answer is 15 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train A = 457 m

Speed of Train A = 18 m/s

Length of Train B = 113 m

Speed of Train B = 20 m/s

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed
